context: District trip sheet before departure (#2307), shown in the chairman's office.
intent: Explain the current state of the trip and its selected business.
keep: One short statement per line. The selected bargain is a proposal carried to the district.
strings: Reason shown under the disabled trip button when the only current district business consists of allocation lots available by mail.
В районе дел пока нет — лоты лимита доступны письмом.
Nothing to settle now — allocation lots come by mail.
On the sheet before departure, identifies the plan position and signed adjustment the chairman selected for discussion.
